name: uj-website
description: Usama Javed Technology Solution: bilingual website and admin portal on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.build: npm --prefix uj-web ci && npm --prefix uj-web run build
scripts.dev:api: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && wrangler d1 migrations apply uj-website --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply uj-website --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run cf-deploy
scripts.cf-deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply uj-website --remote
